title: Align the cross profile when an axle and hole match but collide
applicability: Use when a nominally compatible shaft and hole report geometry interference in the proposed seated pose. Inspect the clocking and insertion depth of both connectors.
aliases: cross axle will not go in
shaft fits profile but is blocked
steps: Inspect the target and nearby parts. A compatible pair solves the connector pose. Use a trial to check the resulting bodies and confirm whether the shaft hits its own hole or an obstruction on the approach side.

In the example, 3705 in the 7229 cross hole at 45° intersects the beam. Trial the matching keyed orientation at 0° before committing. A different job may require a change in insertion depth or clearance outside the hole.

Apply only the clear trial and verify the resulting components and collision report. The example verifies the seated pose. For a physical insertion sequence, separately check that the shaft can reach it with other parts installed.
expected: The 45° trial reports assembly.collision and leaves the beam untouched. The 0° trial seats the axle in a valid connected assembly.
